subject: general
question: Which port situated at the head of Gulf of Kutch has helped to reduce the pressure at Mumbai port?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kandla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kandla Port** is located at the head of the **Gulf of Kutch**, in the state of Gujarat, India.
 
• It is one of the **largest ports in India** and was developed to reduce the pressure on the **Mumbai Port**, which was handling a significant amount of cargo.
 
• The port is a major hub for importing and exporting goods such as **petroleum, chemicals, grains, and fertilizers.**
 
• Kandla Port is renowned for its **strategic location**, offering connectivity to various international trade routes.
 
• It is equipped with **modern facilities** that cater to the needs of industries and businesses, making it a vital part of India's maritime trade network.
 
• The port plays a key role in facilitating trade with countries in the **Middle East, Africa, and Europe.**
 
• Kandla is also known for its **Free Trade Warehousing Zone (FTWZ),** which enhances storage and trade efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Haldia Port**__

 __
 
• **Haldia Port** is located in **West Bengal** near the mouth of the **Hooghly River**.
 
• It primarily handles cargo such as **petroleum products, chemicals, and bulk raw materials.**
 
• It serves as a supplementary port to the **Kolkata Port** and caters to the needs of eastern India.
 
 
 
• **Kolkata Port**__
 __
 
• **Kolkata Port** is India's oldest operating port and is located on the banks of the **Hooghly River**.
 
• It primarily handles **containerized cargo**, including goods such as textiles, tea, and jute.
 
• Kolkata Port serves as a gateway to the northeastern states and neighboring countries like **Bangladesh and Bhutan.**
 
 
 
• **Kochi Port**__
 
 
• **Kochi Port** is situated in **Kerala** and operates as a major port on the southwestern coast of India.
 
• This port is a key hub for the export of goods such as **spices, tea, coffee, and seafood.**
 
• Kochi Port is also known for its role in India's **international container transshipment** due to its proximity to shipping routes.
